To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the shape representation scheme of objects present in a digital image is robust to incomplete representation of the objects; and (b) the LVQ algorithms have good generalization ability and can learn the data model in an efficient manner, and are robust to noise.

the robustness of shape descriptor depends on the nature of the descriptor and the type of incomplete representation of the object, and the dynamics and the performance of LVQ algorithms are dependent on the data model.

the robustness of shape descriptors is a function of the number of samples, the number of training samples, the number and type of shape features, the type of representation and the number of training iterations.
